description: Ministry of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs - Notify the entry of Department of Polymer Science to the University of Sri Jayawardanepura, that published on Gaz. Ex. No. 1603/35
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order issued under Section 27(1) of the Act that modifies the schedule specifying faculties and departments of the University of Sri Jayewardenepura. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on statutory instruments and regulatory amendments rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
